deadline_review.candidate: feat/temporal-budget-propagation; changed dispositions describe this candidate, separate runtime/readiness candidates remain explicitly distinct
deadline_review.method: Grouped source review of harness/support, verification/acceptance, execution/cleanup, runtime transports/providers, storage/telemetry and intentionally ongoing services. Static inventory is distinct from executed validation.

groups.disposition: Reused shared Clock/WaitBudget; inherited Deadline never extends parent.
groups.limits: Late truthy predicate accepted; only explicit safe native Conflict retries; independent real watchdog required for fake clocks.

groups.disposition: Changed: inner polling inherits outer expiry; remaining is zero after expiry and another CLI dispatch is refused.
groups.limits: CLI process creation and OS scheduling are cooperative; an unrelated subprocess timeout remains a separate failure.

groups.disposition: Changed: shared bounded_wait; old return and exception policies preserved.
groups.limits: Generic predicates do not inherit native safe-conflict retry policy.

groups.disposition: Changed: socket and selector waits receive actual remainder with no positive floor.
groups.limits: EOF/missing-marker and underlying socket errors retain their previous meanings.

groups.boundary: scenario start -> request write -> complete response
groups.disposition: Changed: nonblocking writes and framed reads share the scenario Deadline.
groups.limits: Client close has separate 5 s graceful, 1 s terminate and 1 s kill stages; blocked remote work is not cancelled by an RPC timeout.

groups.disposition: Changed: incomplete lines cannot bypass startup bound; probe polling sleeps clamp.
groups.limits: Deferred host termination and kill each retain a separate 10 s cleanup allowance; readiness does not prove later completion.

groups.disposition: Changed: one Deadline bounds safe-conflict retry admission and sleeps.
groups.limits: Application calls, snapshots and final diagnostic save are synchronous cooperative work; outer command owns process watchdog.

groups.purpose: execution and cancellation with separate cleanup
groups.boundary: spawn -> exit/check timeout/run cancel -> graceful then forced cleanup
groups.disposition: Changed: grace starts before TERM; forced 5 s shared across KILL, drain, reap and group verification; current check/run scope preserved.
groups.limits: Proc scans and scheduling can overrun; no claimed cancellation of detached or unidentified foreign processes.

groups.boundary: worker termination -> host close -> owned survivor verification
groups.disposition: Changed: exact remaining terminal grace, no .1 floor; elapsed_seconds, overrun_seconds and cooperative budget scope retained.
groups.limits: Terminal observation, forced close tail and shutdown port calls have no total-call timeout. Outer command is independent watchdog.

groups.boundary: terminal close -> TERM grace -> 2 s KILL phase
groups.disposition: Changed: phase signals, observation and sleeps spend their own allowance; separate stages retained.
groups.limits: Host close/shutdown remain cooperative; kept presentation is excluded from work cleanup.
